# Load and Normalize data

Load libraries:
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(STutility)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(reshape2)
library(corrplot)
library(lawstat)
library(MASS)
library(viridis)
```

Load ST data:
```{r}

infoTable <- read.csv("spatial_data/infoTable.csv", sep = ";")


se <- InputFromTable(infotable = infoTable, 
                      minUMICountsPerGene = 100, 
                      minSpotsPerGene = 5,
                      minUMICountsPerSpot = 500,
                      platform =  "Visium")

```


Load image:
```{r}
se <- LoadImages(se, time.resolve = FALSE)
```

View image:
```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
ImagePlot(se, method = "raster", annotate = FALSE)
```

# QC plots  {.tabset}

QC metrics se:
```{r}
# Collect all genes coded on the mitochondrial genome
mt.genes <- grep(pattern = "^mt-", x = rownames(se), value = TRUE)
se$percent.mito <- (Matrix::colSums(se@assays$RNA@counts[mt.genes, ])/Matrix::colSums(se@assays$RNA@counts))*100

# Collect all genes coding for ribosomal proteins
rp.genes <- grep(pattern = "^Rpl|^Rps", x = rownames(se), value = TRUE)
se$percent.ribo <- (Matrix::colSums(se@assays$RNA@counts[rp.genes, ])/Matrix::colSums(se@assays$RNA@counts))*100
```

## percent.mito
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ST.FeaturePlot(se, features = "percent.mito", cols = c("lightgray", "mistyrose", "red", "dark red", "black"), pt.size = 1.3)

```

## percent.ribo
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ST.FeaturePlot(se, features = "percent.ribo", cols = c("lightgray", "mistyrose", "red", "dark red", "black"), pt.size = 1.3)
```

## nFeature_RNA
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ST.FeaturePlot(se, features = "nFeature_RNA", cols = c("lightgray", "mistyrose", "red", "dark red", "black"), pt.size = 1.3)
```

## nCount_RNA
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ST.FeaturePlot(se, features = "nCount_RNA", cols = c("lightgray", "mistyrose", "red", "dark red", "black"), pt.size = 1.3)
```


# Spatial clusters  {.tabset}

Normalize data: se <- SCTransform(se,return.only.var.genes = T)
```{r, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
se <- SCTransform(se,return.only.var.genes = T)
```

Load cluster annotations
```{r}
seurat_clusters <- read.csv(file = "spatial_structures/seurat_clusters.csv", sep = ";")
```

Add annotations to seurat object
```{r}
rownames(seurat_clusters) <- seurat_clusters$Barcode
seurat_clusters$Barcode <- NULL
se$seurat_clusters <- seurat_clusters
se$seurat_clusters_plot <- as.factor(se$seurat_clusters) # For plotting of spatial structures
head(se[[]])
```

## Plot seurat_clusters
```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
n <- 19
qual_col_pals = brewer.pal.info[brewer.pal.info$category == 'qual',]
col_vector = unlist(mapply(brewer.pal, qual_col_pals$maxcolors, rownames(qual_col_pals)))
col_vector[6] <- "black"
col_vector[8] <- "lightpink"
col_vector[10] <- "firebrick1"
col_vector[11] <- "darkmagenta"
col_vector[14] <- "darkorange2"
col_vector[18] <- "deepskyblue"
  
col_vector <- col_vector[1:19]

se <- SetIdent(se, value = "seurat_clusters_plot")
ST.FeaturePlot(object = se, features = "seurat_clusters_plot", pt.size = 1, cols = col_vector)
```

## FeatureOverlay seurat_clusters
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
spot_alpha = 0.5
point.size = 1

FeatureOverlay(se, 
               features = c("seurat_clusters_plot"),
               pt.alpha = spot_alpha,
               pt.size = point.size,
               add.alpha=T,
               ncols = 1,
               cols = col_vector)
```


```{r}
all_gene_sets <- all_gene_sets_OpenTargets

all_gene_sets <- append(all_gene_sets,window50_rank_list_BIP_Drugs)
```


# Score data based on gene sets

AddModuleScore loop se:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
score.mat <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(all_gene_sets), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), "% of genes present"))

for (i in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
  genes <- unlist(all_gene_sets[i]) # character vector of genes in a gene set
  score.mat[i] <- mean(genes %in% rownames(se)) # calculate and collect % of genes present in se from the gene set
  print(list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
  se <- AddModuleScore(se,list(genes), ctrl = 100, name = list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
}

```


```{r, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

score.mat <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(all_gene_sets), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), "% of genes present"))

for (i in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
  genes <- unlist(all_gene_sets[i]) # character vector of genes in a gene set
  score.mat[i] <- mean(genes %in% rownames(se)) # calculate and collect % of genes present in se from the gene set
  print(list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
  se <- AddModuleScore(se,list(genes), ctrl = 100, name = list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
}

```

Print % of genes present in scores, should be 100 %
```{r}
score.mat*100
```

# NULL set permutation


Load perm.mat from NULL gene sets
```{r class.source = 'fold-show'}
perm.mat.window50 <- readRDS(file = "Permutation_matrices/perm.mat_p10000_g50.RDS")
perm.mat.genetic <- readRDS(file = "Permutation_matrices/perm.mat_p10000_g80.RDS")
perm.mat.drugs <- readRDS(file = "Permutation_matrices/perm.mat_p10000_g152.RDS")
```


Permutation test settings
```{r class.source = 'fold-show'}
permutation.nr <- 10000

perm.mat.window50.data <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.window50)
perm.mat.genetic.data <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.genetic)
perm.mat.drugs.data <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.drugs)

nr_of_tests <- 19 

#Cluster names
cluster_names <- rep("cluster_", length(table(se$seurat_clusters)))
cluster_names <- paste0(cluster_names,as.character(0:(length(table(se$seurat_clusters))-1)))

#P-value matrices
p.val.mat.g <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = 2, ncol = length(cluster_names), dimnames = list(c("-log10(p.val)","-log10(p.val.adj)"),cluster_names))
p.val.mat.d <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = 2, ncol = length(cluster_names), dimnames = list(c("-log10(p.val)","-log10(p.val.adj)"),cluster_names))

```

## BIP_Genetic all structures {.tabset}

Extract quantile: BIP_Genetic all structures
```{r}
meta_data_vector <- NULL
BIP_Genetic_structure <- NULL

for (i in 1:length(meta_data_se_BIP_Genetic)){
        meta_data_vector$Rank <- as.character(i)
        meta_data_vector$quantile <- quantile(as.numeric(meta_data_se_BIP_Genetic[,i]), probs = 0.99)
        BIP_Genetic_structure <- rbind(BIP_Genetic_structure,meta_data_vector)
}
rownames(BIP_Genetic_structure) <- 1:length(meta_data_se_BIP_Genetic)
BIP_Genetic_structure <- as.data.frame(BIP_Genetic_structure)
BIP_Genetic_structure <- unlist(BIP_Genetic_structure$quantile)
BIP_Genetic_structure <- as.data.frame(BIP_Genetic_structure)
BIP_Genetic_structure$Rank <- 1:length(meta_data_se_BIP_Genetic)
colnames(BIP_Genetic_structure) <- c("quantile","Rank")
```

### BIP_Genetic all structures
```{r, fig.width=10}
plot(BIP_Genetic_structure$Rank,BIP_Genetic_structure$quantile, main = "BIP Genetic all structures", xlab = "Rank", ylab = "Score", type = "o", ylim=c(-0.1,0.5))
axis(1, at = seq(1, 200, by = 1), cex.axis = 0.5)

abline(h = max(perm.mat.window50), col="darkred", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = quantile(as.numeric(perm.mat.window50), probs = 0.95), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = median(perm.mat.window50), col="blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = quantile(as.numeric(perm.mat.window50), probs = 0.05), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = min(perm.mat.window50), col="darkred", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
meta_data_vector <- NULL

for (i in 1:length(meta_data_se_0_BIP_Genetic)){
        meta_data_vector$Rank <- as.character(i)
        meta_data_vector$Median <- median(meta_data_se_0_BIP_Genetic[,i])
        BIP_Genetic_structure_0 <- rbind(BIP_Genetic_structure_0,meta_data_vector)
}
```

### BIP_Genetic windows
```{r, fig.width=10}
plot(BIP_Genetic_structure_0$Rank,BIP_Genetic_structure_0$Median, main = "BIP Genetic Structure 0", xlab = "Rank", ylab = "Score", type = "o", ylim=c(-0.3,0.3))
axis(1, at = seq(1, 200, by = 1), cex.axis = 0.5)

abline(h = max(perm.mat.window50[,1]), col="darkred", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

abline(h = median(perm.mat.window50[,1]), col="blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = quantile(as.numeric(perm.mat.window50[,1]), probs = 0.05), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(h = min(perm.mat.window50[,1]), col="darkred", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

Permutation p-value windows: BIP Genetic Structure 0
```{r}

#P.value across window ranks
Rank_names <- rep("Rank_nr", length(window50_rank_list_BIP_Genetic))
Rank_names <- paste0(Rank_names,sep=1:length(Rank_names))

#P.value matrix
p.mat.cluster0 <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(window50_rank_list_BIP_Genetic), ncol = 2, dimnames = list(Rank_names,c("p.val","p.val.adj")))


for (i in 1:length(window50_rank_list_BIP_Genetic)){
  
  OT_genetic_window <- as.numeric(BIP_Genetic_structure_0[i,2])
  perm.mat.window50.cluster0_bigger_window <- subset(perm.mat.window50.data,perm.mat.window50.data$cluster_0 >= OT_genetic_window)
  
  cluster0_w_p.val <- (nrow(perm.mat.window50.cluster0_bigger_window)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)
  p.mat.cluster0[i,1] <- as.numeric(cluster0_w_p.val)
  
  cluster0_w_p.val.adj <- p.adjust(cluster0_w_p.val,method = c("bonferroni"), n=nr_of_tests)
  p.mat.cluster0[i,2] <- as.numeric(cluster0_w_p.val.adj)
}

p.mat.cluster0[,1]
```

### P.val.adj structure
```{r}
# Median score of NULL gene set permutations
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_0 <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.genetic.data$cluster_0)
colnames(median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_0) <- c("Median_scores")

# permutation p-value
perm.mat.genetic.cluster0_bigger <- subset(perm.mat.genetic.data,perm.mat.genetic.data$cluster_0 >= as.numeric(median(se_0$OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_1)))

cluster0_p.val.g <- (nrow(perm.mat.genetic.cluster0_bigger)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)
cluster0_p.val.g.adj <- p.adjust(cluster0_p.val.g,method = c("bonferroni"), n=nr_of_tests) # Bonferroni

p.val.mat.g[1,1] <- -log10(cluster0_p.val.g)
p.val.mat.g[2,1] <- -log10(cluster0_p.val.g.adj)

cluster0_p.val.g.adj_text <- as.character(round(cluster0_p.val.g.adj, digits = 4))
cluster0_p.val.g.adj_text <- paste0(c("p.val.adj = "),cluster0_p.val.g.adj_text)

theme_set(theme_classic()) # Density plot
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_0 %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Median_scores)) +
    geom_density(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.8)+ 
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(median(se_0$OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_1)), color = "purple", size=1)+
  annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label= cluster0_p.val.g.adj_text)+
  ggtitle("Structure 0")+
  xlab("Median score NULL gene set")+
  ylab("Density")

```

```{r}
for (i in 1:length(window50_rank_list_BIP_Genetic)){
  
  OT_genetic_window <- as.numeric(BIP_Genetic_structure_17[i,2])
  perm.mat.window50.cluster17_bigger_window <- subset(perm.mat.window50.data,perm.mat.window50.data$cluster_17 >= OT_genetic_window)
  
  cluster17_w_p.val <- (nrow(perm.mat.window50.cluster17_bigger_window)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)
  p.mat.cluster17[i,1] <- as.numeric(cluster17_w_p.val)
  
  cluster17_w_p.val.adj <- p.adjust(cluster17_w_p.val,method = c("bonferroni"), n=nr_of_tests)
  p.mat.cluster17[i,2] <- as.numeric(cluster17_w_p.val.adj)
}
```

```{r}
# Median score of NULL gene set permutations
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_17 <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.genetic.data$cluster_17)
colnames(median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_17) <- c("Median_scores")

# permutation p-value
perm.mat.genetic.cluster17_bigger <- subset(perm.mat.genetic.data,perm.mat.genetic.data$cluster_17 >= as.numeric(median(se_17$OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_1)))

cluster17_p.val.g <- (nrow(perm.mat.genetic.cluster17_bigger)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)
cluster17_p.val.g.adj <- p.adjust(cluster17_p.val.g,method = c("bonferroni"), n=nr_of_tests) # Bonferroni

cluster17_p.val.g.adj_text <- as.character(round(cluster17_p.val.g.adj, digits = 4))
cluster17_p.val.g.adj_text <- paste0(c("p.val.adj = "),cluster17_p.val.g.adj_text)

p.val.mat.g[1,18] <- -log10(cluster17_p.val.g)
p.val.mat.g[2,18] <- -log10(cluster17_p.val.g.adj)

theme_set(theme_classic()) # Density plot
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_17 %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Median_scores)) +
    geom_density(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.8)+ 
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(median(se_17$OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_1)), color = "purple", size=1)+
  annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label= cluster17_p.val.g.adj_text)+
  ggtitle("Structure 17")+
  xlab("Median score NULL gene set")+
  ylab("Density")

```

```{r}
# Median score of NULL gene set permutations
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_1 <- as.data.frame(perm.mat.drugs.data$cluster_1)

# permutation p-value
perm.mat.drugs.cluster1_bigger <- subset(perm.mat.drugs.data,perm.mat.drugs.data$cluster_1 >= as.numeric(median(se_1$OpenTargets_BIP_Drugs_1)))

cluster1_p.val.d <- (nrow(perm.mat.drugs.cluster1_bigger)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)

cluster1_p.val.d.adj_text <- as.character(round(cluster1_p.val.d.adj, digits = 4))
cluster1_p.val.d.adj_text <- paste0(c("p.val.adj = "),cluster1_p.val.d.adj_text)

p.val.mat.d[2,2] <- -log10(cluster1_p.val.d.adj)

theme_set(theme_classic()) # Density plot
median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_1 %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Median_scores)) +
    geom_density(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.8)+

  annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label= cluster1_p.val.d.adj_text)+
  ggtitle("Structure 1")+
  xlab("Median score NULL gene set")+
  ylab("Density")
```

```{r}
# Median score of NULL gene set permutations
```

```{r}
cluster5_p.val.d <- (nrow(perm.mat.drugs.cluster5_bigger)+1)/(permutation.nr+1)
cluster5_p.val.d.adj <- p.adjust(cluster5_p.val.d,method = c("bonferroni"), n=nr_of_tests) # Bonferroni

cluster5_p.val.d.adj_text <- as.character(round(cluster5_p.val.d.adj, digits = 4))
cluster5_p.val.d.adj_text <- paste0(c("p.val.adj = "),cluster5_p.val.d.adj_text)

p.val.mat.d[2,6] <- -log10(cluster5_p.val.d.adj)

median_score_NULL_permutations_cluster_5 %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Median_scores)) +
    geom_density(fill="#69b3a2", alpha=0.8)+ 
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(median(se_5$OpenTargets_BIP_Drugs_1)), color = "purple", size=1)+
  annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label= cluster5_p.val.d.adj_text)+
  ggtitle("Structure 5")+
  xlab("Median score NULL gene set")+
  ylab("Density")

```

# Jaccard index

Jaccard function:
```{r}
jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  intersection = length(intersect(a, b))
  union = length(a) + length(b) - intersection
  return (intersection/union)
}
```


Print all genes shared combinations:
```{r}
# två for-loopar
# Börja med att skapa en tom matrix med lika många kolumner som rader
# kolumn- och rad-namn ska vara samma som namnen på hallmark gene sets
length.mat <- matrix(data = NA, 
                  nrow = length(all_gene_sets), 
                  ncol = length(all_gene_sets), 
                  dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), 
                                  names(all_gene_sets)))


# Iterera över två for-loopar, en för rader och en för kolumner
for (i in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
  for (j in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
    # Spara jaccard mellan par av gene sets
    length.mat[i, j] <- jaccard(all_gene_sets[[i]],all_gene_sets[[j]])
  }
}


```


```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
length.mat.df <- as.data.frame(length.mat)

library(tidyverse)

df2 <- length.mat.df %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  gather(colname, value, -rowname)
head(df2)

df2$value <- ifelse(df2$rowname == df2$colname, NA, df2$value)

```


Re-format plot
```{r, fig.height=28, fig.width=35}


# Create a ggheatmap
ggheatmap <- ggplot(df2, aes(colname, rowname, fill = value))+
 geom_tile(color = "white")+
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", 
   midpoint = 0, space = "Lab", 
    name="Jaccard\nindex", limits=c(0,1)) +
  theme_minimal()+ # minimal theme
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, 
    size = 12, hjust = 1))+
 coord_fixed()

# Print the heatmap
ggheatmap + ggtitle("All gene sets")


```
